# KSE hex stickers

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(magick)

resize <- function(path_in, path_out) {
  image <- image_read(path_in)
  image <- image_resize(image, "278x")
  image_write(image, path_out)
}

# Refresh thumbs/<lang>/ for logo/<lang>/ and print a gallery table.
gallery <- function(lang, cols = 5) {
  logos <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(dir(file.path("logo", lang), pattern = "\\.png$"))
  if (!length(logos)) return(invisible())
  png <- file.path("logo", lang, paste0(logos, ".png"))
  thumb <- file.path("thumbs", lang, paste0(logos, ".png"))
  dir.create(file.path("thumbs", lang), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  outdated <- !file.exists(thumb) | file.mtime(thumb) < file.mtime(png)
  invisible(Map(resize, png[outdated], thumb[outdated]))

  img <- glue::glue('<img alt="Logo for {logos}" src="{thumb}" width="120" height="139">')
  png_link <- glue::glue('<a href="{png}">{logos}.png</a>')
  cell <- paste0("<td>", img, "<br />", png_link, "</td>")
  row_id <- rep(seq_len(ceiling(length(cell) / cols)), each = cols, length.out = length(cell))
  row_cells <- split(cell, row_id)

  cat("<table>\n")
  cat(paste0("<tr>", sapply(row_cells, paste, collapse = ""), "</tr>"), sep = "")
  cat("\n</table>\n\n")
}
```

## R

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
gallery("R")
```

## Python

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
gallery("python")
```

## Usage

Every sticker has an R script in `R/` and an equivalent Python script in `python/`;
the shared generators are `R/hexsticker.R` and `python/hexsticker.py`.
They write `logo/R/<script name>.png` and `logo/python/<script name>.png` respectively
(43.9 × 50.8 mm, the hexb.in / Posit size, at 1000 dpi).
Render this README afterwards to refresh `thumbs/` and the galleries.

**R** (packages pinned with renv):

```sh
Rscript R/math840-26.R
```

**Python** (managed with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/); the only dependency is matplotlib):

```sh
uv run python/math840-26.py
uv run python/math840-26.py out/   # optional: write to another folder
```

The Python generator lives in `python/hexsticker.py`. Fonts are fetched from Google Fonts
once and cached in `.cache/fonts`.
